title: Match: Bright Pluck
brief: Match this sound: a short, bright pluck. Press "Play target" to hear it as many times as you like — comparing from memory is a different skill than the one this teaches. Build VCO → VCF → VCA → Output, then patch the ADSR's "Out" into the VCA's "CV" jack so the envelope gates the sound. A quick Attack and a short Decay make the pluck snap in and fall away; the VCF's Cut knob controls how bright it is. Press Check when you think you're close — the feedback will name whichever is off: brightness, or timing.
